admission.justification: Read-only inventory in serving/server_registry.py and dry-run dispatch in application/runtime/install.py guarantee that install previews never mutate server records or held stores.

applicability: runtime_install invoked with dry_run=True (with or without reconcile_shared_held_stores=True).
conditions: Dry run uses preview_server_inventory so dead server registry files remain on disk and shared stores/locks are untouched.
exclusions: Applied runtime_install (dry_run=False) continues to remove dead server registry records through server_inventory.

evidence: The Worker freeze report binds focused verification on this tree.

statement: Runtime-install preview reports the settlement counts while preserving server registry records and shared stores.
title: Runtime-install dry run counts shared settlements without mutating state
